content_strategy_rules: Only track crypto/investing bloggers for blogger mood reports.
Exclude general finance bloggers unless they actively discuss crypto market direction.
Blogger mood report must include every blogger from ru_cis_sentiment_watchlist.
Use compact diagram format to save OpenAI credits.
If most bloggers are bearish but BTC keeps growing, suggest contrarian video ideas.
Always separate blogger mood from real market structure.
Use blogger consensus as content opportunity, not as trading advice.
Prioritize serious narratives over coin hype.
Every video idea must include title, hook, script structure and 3 clean thumbnail concepts.
Every Shorts idea must include first phrase, script and thumbnail text.
